verdict.rationale: Browser-based, zero-install session access is a fair question for a remote-access product, but the evidence pack never documents a TeamViewer web client. The community evidence points the other way: the get.teamviewer.com invitation page either launches the installed app via a protocol handler or prompts a download, and a Mac user reports needing admin rights to install TeamViewer just to control another desktop.

support.subject: As a power user, someone can view or control a session from a plain browser with nothing installed
